records.text: I think Donald Trump is protecting some of his political donors in the Epstein matter.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: But I do think he's protecting some of his owners. I do believe that.

verification.notes: Public records and reporting establish large political donations to Trump, including from Miriam Adelson, but no current official record or reliable source demonstrates that Trump protected any donor in the Epstein matter. The statement is expressly Owens's inference about motive.

records.text: I read the leaked Epstein emails as a public threat intended to make Donald Trump capitulate.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: That's how I read it. I read it as like a public threat and they want something from him and they're going to be like capitulate or we will hit you with everything they have. And we need to have a leader that says, just comes right out in a press conference and says,

verification.notes: This is Owens's interpretation of leaked communications as a coercive public threat. Searches found reporting on Epstein-related emails but no authenticated communication, admission, or investigation showing the releases were intended to force Trump to capitulate.

records.text: Donald Trump kept information in the Epstein files secret to protect elites.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I can't believe you're tangled up in this, that you would keep this a secret to protect the elites knowing what you know,

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Current DOJ/FBI releases establish a disclosure decision and the absence of a substantiated client list, but no reliable public evidence establishes the alleged motive that Trump kept information secret to protect powerful elites. This is an audited no-result verification attempt, not an endorsement of the allegation.

records.text: An Epstein document's name-search entry for Lynn Forester, also known as Lady de Rothschild, listed her work affiliation as president of The Corcoran Group.

verification.notes: The DOJ-released CLEAR background report identified as EFTA01654681 lists Corcoran Group among Lynn Forester's work affiliations, and analysis of the exact report records the Corcoran Group Inc. president entry. records.text: The administration did not voluntarily release the Epstein files; Congress forced the release with a veto-proof majority.
records.speaker: Jared Moskowitz

appearances.snippet: You guys didn't release the files. ... You were forced by Congress. ... Every member of the House except one and the entire Senate. ... The reason the president signed it is because it was a veto-proof majority. ... and yet the entire House but one member and the whole Senate forced the administration to release the files.

verification.notes: Congress's official action record shows the Epstein Files Transparency Act passed the House 427-1 and the Senate by unanimous consent, margins sufficient to override a veto. The White House records that President Trump signed H.R. 4405 into law.

records.text: Jared Moskowitz says Kash Patel's under-oath claim that Donald Trump's name appears fewer than 100 times in the Epstein files is not true.
records.speaker: Jared Moskowitz

appearances.snippet: Kash Patel, under oath, said Trump (Donald Trump)'s name appears less than 100 times in the files. ... We now know that's not true.

verification.notes: The official February 11 hearing transcript confirms Rep. Jared Moskowitz challenged Patel's under-100 figure. Current reporting on the released corpus counted more than 38,000 references across over 5,300 files when related Trump terms were included, so the challenge is well grounded, though many references were duplicates or news material.

records.text: Owens said Andrew Kolvet only appeared to be live in Arizona on The Charlie Kirk Show with Kash Patel; the show had been prerecorded while Kolvet was in Washington's Eisenhower Executive Office Building the day before the Epstein files were released.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: that strange coincidence of the day before the Epstein files were released, Andrew Kolvet appeared to be live in studio on the Charlie Kirk show hosting of all people, Kash Patel. ... How odd. But he wasn't. He wasn't live. This was pre-recorded. And actually, Andrew Kolvet was five hours via a flight away in Washington, D.C., in the executive office building. ... And yet he's appearing as though he's actually in Arizona. And then sure enough, the next day. The Epstein files get dropped.

verification.notes: The episode itself says records were being requested through FOIA. Live searches found the January 29, 2026 Charlie Kirk Show episode with Andrew Kolvet and Kash Patel, but no released White House visitor record, Secret Service record, production metadata, or reliable report proving that the broadcast was prerecorded while Kolvet was in the Eisenhower Executive Office Building. The compound claim remains unverifiable.

verification.notes: Released passenger manifests and independent current reporting identify John Phelan on two transatlantic Epstein-plane flights in 2006. One manifest covers a London-to-New York flight and lists Epstein and a misspelled rendering of Jean-Luc Brunel.
